multiplicity: BH-FDR q=0.05 (stage1); Bonferroni (stage2 m=46, stage3 m=20)
binning: numeric=5 causal quintiles on a trailing 2000-bar rank; bool=2; categorical=declared levels
interactions: fully blind and mechanical: the 10 pairs among the top-5 stage-2 ranked features, plus the 10 pairs formed by crossing each top-5 feature with the next-ranked feature (ranks 6-10) at matching index = 20 exactly. No feature name is needed to execute this rule, and no other interaction is permitted inside V2.
